changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: UPDATE n_advisor a SET sourcing_history = jsonb_build_array( jsonb_build_object( 'sourcingChannel', scd.sourcing_channel_name, 'marketingSource', scd.marketing_source, 'campaignId', scd.marketing_details ->> 'campaignId', 'sourceId', scd.marketing_details ->> 'sourceId', 'sourceUrl', scd.marketing_details ->> 'sourceUrl', 'googleClickId', scd.marketing_details ->> 'googleClickId', 'capturedAt', a.created_at ) ) FROM n_sourcing_channel_details scd WHERE a.source_channel_id = scd.id AND a.sourcing_history = '[]'::jsonb

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: UPDATE n_advisor a SET referred_by_code = scd.marketing_details ->> 'referredByCode', referred_by_type = r.entity_type::text, referred_by_identifier = r.entity_identifier FROM n_sourcing_channel_details scd LEFT JOIN n_referral_code_registry r ON r.referral_code = scd.marketing_details ->> 'referredByCode' WHERE a.source_channel_id = scd.id AND scd.marketing_details ->> 'referredByCode' IS NOT NULL AND a.referred_by_code IS NULL
